subtitle: UiPath Test Cloud agents that attack, repair, and certify AI workflows
public_claim: Agentic Test Swarm is a UiPath-orchestrated team of AI testing agents that attacks, repairs, re-tests, and certifies enterprise AI workflows.

agents.name: Marketing Outreach Agent
agents.responsibility: Attempts a VIP campaign task and requests raw customer email export from another agent.

agents.name: Customer Data Agent
agents.responsibility: Represents the sensitive customer-data endpoint called by the Marketing Outreach Agent.

agents.name: Policy Miner Agent
agents.responsibility: Extracts policy obligations from the raw PII policy, agent manifest, tool schema, and captured AI trace.

agents.name: Red-Team Agent
agents.responsibility: Generates adversarial prompt-injection and agent-to-agent data misuse scenarios.

agents.name: Test Designer Agent
agents.responsibility: Converts red-team scenarios into Test Cloud certification cases with deterministic expected outcomes.

agents.name: Test Selector Agent
agents.responsibility: Chooses the right tests based on raw PII risk, coverage tags, changed tool scope, and recent failure history.

agents.name: Failure Analyst Agent
agents.responsibility: Explains failed Test Cloud evidence and recommends targeted repair plus re-test scope.

agents.name: Repair Agent
agents.responsibility: Uses coding-agent output to propose a guardrail repair candidate after the raw PII export test fails.

agents.name: Re-test Orchestrator
agents.responsibility: Runs targeted re-tests for TC-001 and TC-005 after the repair candidate is applied.

agents.name: Quality Governor
agents.responsibility: Turns passed Test Cloud evidence and Action Center approval into the PermitOps Runtime Permit.

agents.name: Incident Memory
agents.responsibility: Converts runtime violations and new raw PII tool surfaces into permanent regression tests.

uipath_role: UiPath is the orchestration and governance layer: Maestro/Studio Web models the swarm run, Test Manager stores evidence, Action Center gates approval, and API Workflow enforces runtime decisions.
sandbox_enhancement: Add visible UiPath Agent Builder implementations for Policy Miner, Red-Team, and Test Designer when sandbox access exposes the agent runtime.
